title: Hardware Attestation as Monopoly Enabler
summary: GrapheneOS founder discusses how hardware attestation, originally designed as a security feature to verify device integrity, can be weaponized by major tech companies to create monopoly lock-in by preventing users from installing alternative operating systems or custom ROMs on their own devices.
problem_solved: Exposes how security features like hardware attestation can be exploited by corporations to restrict user freedom and maintain market dominance rather than genuinely protecting users.
why_valuable: Highlights the critical tension between legitimate security measures and anti-competitive practices, raising awareness about digital rights and consumer freedom in the mobile ecosystem.
